summary: Adds the second baseline EDO provider, Saby EDO, against the same provider-neutral signed-document/status contract and Task-064 admission boundary.

impacts.evidence: All durable operational data is organization/workspace scoped and new PostgreSQL tables use forced RLS; global provider manifests contain no tenant payload.
Sensitive credentials remain behind SecretAccessor/isolated ports; marking codes/card data/private keys are not persisted in generic evidence.
No existing public HTTP/OpenAPI operation is removed or changed; the task is internal/additive connector/domain capability work.
No existing EventBus schema is removed or changed; new evidence/state is persisted through additive domain contracts.
Connector SDK root Connector/Runtime remain frozen; only additive capability-specific interfaces/types are introduced where required.
Expand-only migration migrations/000043_edo_connector_sdk_providers.sql adds tenant-scoped state/evidence without destructive changes.
Provider code has no direct Core/SQL authority, production networking is host-injected, credentials stay opaque and regulated writes fail closed where applicable.
Regulated signing/VetIS/EDO workflows require explicit approval or signed artifact evidence; non-applicable read-only paths cannot escalate into writes.
Append-only status/signing/fiscal/payment/tracking/event evidence preserves remote references, timestamps and correlation without uncontrolled payload copies.
Idempotency keys, remote authoritative status and replay-safe evidence prevent duplicate side effects and local state from overriding provider state.
No arbitrary egress is granted; payment callbacks require verification and replay evidence, while other adapters use typed host transports.
Normalized remote errors/status and bounded timestamps provide measurable availability/lag without logging credentials or sensitive payloads.
Additive migrations/tables can remain during binary rollback; providers can be disabled without rewriting immutable evidence.
Unit tests cover task invariants; admitted providers include deterministic Task-064 13-check reports and final repository gates are required.
